en: Ah, a visitor. Let me tell you something, if I may. It was I who taught Wallace everything he knows.
Once I was the Gym Leader here, then he took my place. Now that he has gone off, the Gym is mine again.
Water Pokémon and I move as one, like a dance upon the waves. Let me show you our grace!
Ahahaha, splendid! You are a talent as rare as Wallace himself. I yield.
Please, take this Badge. It is yours by right.
{player} received the Rain Badge from Juan!
With the Rain Badge, every Pokémon obeys you, whatever its level, and Waterfall can be used to climb a waterfall.
And please, accept this as well.
TM03 holds Water Pulse. It strikes with waves of sound, and may leave the foe confused.
May I have your number? I should like to hear how your journey turns out.
TM03 holds Water Pulse. It strikes with waves of sound, and may leave the foe confused.
The Pokémon League waits beyond Ever Grande City. Go, and show them the beauty I saw today.
Yo, champ in the making! Juan's a master of Water Pokémon, so bring Grass and Electric moves.
And mind the ice on the way to him! Step on a tile twice and down you go. Cross every tile once to clear the stairs.
You beat Juan! Check your Trainer Card: with every Badge, you're ready for the Pokémon League!
